what_exists: The chief executive says in interviews that AI is a board priority. No written mandate or budget owner.
Eleven ideas were listed on one workshop slide in May 2026. No owners or data needs.

item: Business case for the first use
what_exists: A one-page case for document search over policies, with a pilot budget approved by IT Steering on 9 June 2026.
UGX 38,000,000 pilot budget approved. No multi-year budget.
No baseline for time to find an answer or days to settle a claim. Only the claims ratio is reported.
A spreadsheet of 14 sources compiled for IT Steering. Four have no owner, five have no sensitivity class, none is in a catalogue.
Finance says customer data is checked every month. No rule list or result log was provided.
No catalogue. Column meanings are in two PDF files from the core banking vendor.
The shared drive holds about 14,000 files. Three editions of the staff handbook sit in one folder.
The head of retail says one customer ID is used across systems. The Risk Committee noted two regulatory returns corrected because of duplicate customer records.
Nightly extract from core banking to a reporting database. Run log kept for 90 days.
Business Continuity Plan sets four hours for core banking. A recovery test is held each March.
IT reports a reporting database and a data lake 'in progress'. No access was shown to the assessor.
Scheduled jobs on two servers using cron. No dependency, retry or alert logic.
No freshness or volume alerts. A six-hour gap in the mobile money log was found by hand.
An internal AI sandbox pilot is approved. It is not yet built.
Kitara says it is registered with the data protection regulator and has named an officer. The certificate was not seen.
The Information Security Policy sets one hour to report internally and 72 hours to report to the regulator.
The Data Classification Standard has four classes. Two sources in the inventory carry the wrong class.
A retention schedule exists. Legal says it is applied. No destruction list was provided.
Kitara Kenya data is processed in Kampala. No transfer assessment is on file.
Ten of 14 sources have an owner. Two owners are recorded as IT while a business unit also claims the source.
The heads say a data council meets informally. There are no minutes.
Classification, retention and acceptable AI use policies exist and were published in 2024 to 2026.
Two analysts in Finance and Risk. No data engineer. No AI training for staff.
